About

About Nexus Driver Solutions

We sit between the application and the first load. Drivers get honest numbers before they commit. Carriers get drivers who fit how they actually run.

Who we are

Nexus Driver Solutions LLC is a CDL-A driver recruiting agency. We recruit Class A drivers for trucking carriers across the United States and help drivers find the right seat: company driver, 1099, team, lease to rent and lease purchase, in dry van, reefer and open deck.

What we do for carriers

Carriers tell us their lanes, equipment, pay and hiring standards. We find CDL-A drivers who match, screen them against those rules, and send only the drivers worth a call. The carrier approves every driver. There is no retainer and no ad budget: our fee starts when the driver starts. How our CDL driver recruiting works →

What we do for drivers

Every job on our board lists pay, home time, truck and requirements before you apply. A recruiter who knows the carrier calls you back, answers the questions that matter and walks you through orientation. Browse current CDL-A jobs →

How we work

  • Numbers up front. Average pay is shown as an average, never as a promise.
  • Carrier rules first. We only submit drivers who meet the carrier's requirements.
  • Confidential by default. Carrier names stay private on our site until a recruiter talks with you.
